config.note: qTcms Chinese reader — manga ids are JS-encoded, reader images are delivered via a signed /read_s request. Static scraping is blocked; requires a CDP-capable Chromium (Settings → Network: point cdp_url at any Chrome/Chromium started with --remote-debugging-port, or enable auto-launch) that runs the site's JS, handles cookies and signing, and exposes the rendered images. No Cloudflare/anti-bot involved — plain rendering is enough. Search is a client-side `<form method=post>` (jQuery `StandardPost('/s', k)`), not a GET query string — hence `searchPostField`.

pages.image_selector: img[src*='ecombdimg'], #cp_img img, .comiclist img, .chapter-content img, #images img, img.lazy
